note: The selection of tests function by function (register decisions 701-719, and the earlier decisions that the task document gives). Each mutant changes a Python script, thus the harness builds nothing, and the CTest tests that run the scripts are the judges: compiled_code_self_test, coverage_hook_self_test and run_tests_self_test for compiled-code.py, which the two other scripts load; coverage_hook_self_test for the start-up check; and run_tests_self_test and run_tests_function_level for the driver. The mutants of the task document come first, then the mutant of decision 716, then the 11 mutants of the rulings 712-715 (decision 717). Four mutants change no decision of the driver (decision 718), and a case that examines the value itself catches each: 'a removed function is not in the function part' is caught by the case that examines that a key that the program does not hold is different from no key, because the driver compares the full part as one hash and the kept part was calculated with the removed function; 'the digests calculated for each function' by the cases that count the digested code sections; 'a kept table is not used' by the case that counts the full reads; and 'ORBSIM_TEST_NAME in the environment part' by the case that calls environment() itself, while run_tree removes the variable before. One survives, declared: the link commands read from Ninja one program at a time, which gives the same commands. No mutant is decisive only in RelWithDebInfo, thus the file runs in build/debug only (decision 709 (6)).

mutants.why: Accepted by the owner, 2026-10-21 (register decision 718). Without the one call for all changed programs, the driver calls Ninja for each program when it calculates its function part, and Ninja gives the same command for each program, thus each decision is the same. Measured in build/debug: one call is approximately 0.1 s for one program and for all 57; 57 calls are 6.8 s. No test counts the calls.
